company.description: Geek Express is an Edtech platform that teaches students STEAM through a comprehensive Arabized journey of online coding classes, DIY STEM kits and self-paced STEAM video lessons. As a startup, we set the model for a futuristic school where students can learn independently of age, location, and medium of learning. We are an online learning platform enabling K-12 students with accredited technology skills through a frictionless journey that guarantees convenience for parents and engagement for students. Students enjoy a gamified journey where they get to develop their own apps, AI programs, and 3D games, guided by Microsoft-certified trainers. They also earn certificates approved by KHDA Dubai, and STEM USA. Our platform sets the model of a futuristic global school of 21st century skills.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $520,000, or 60.47% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,510,846 to $4,957,201, a 1.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
